verify_detail: by the time the Diagnostics screen renders, the state is already fixed for that process. The test is correctly observing genuinely nondeterministic app behavior, so no amount of added waits/retries in the test will fix it.\n\n**Recommendation**: the test needs to either assert on both possible sync states (treat "Retry sync" as conditionally present depending on "Sync idle" vs "Sync unavailable"), or BenchTarget needs a debug/test hook to force `skip=false` deterministically for UI automation.'
